label: Every giving by a one-power HAS_INTELLECT_1 being is by a rational power
meaning: An intellectual y has will (will follows intellect), hence some rational power q; each giving of y exercises some power p of y; with one power, p = q, so the giving exercises a rational power. Constructive. The result classifies the same exercised power; it does not encode which apprehended content, if any, governs this giving. The stronger formative reading requires an explicit interpretation of actual exercise, as assessed in docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md and docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md.
